original_value: The wide proliferation of various wireless communication systems and wireless devices has led to the arrival of big data era in large-scale wireless networks. Big data of large-scale wireless networks has the key features of wide variety, high volume, real-time velocity, and huge value leading to the unique research challenges that are different from existing computing systems. In this article, we present a survey of the state-of-art big data analytics (BDA) approaches for large-scale wireless networks. In particular, we categorize the life cycle of BDA into four consecutive stages: Data Acquisition, Data Preprocessing, Data Storage, and Data Analytics. We then present a detailed survey of the technical solutions to the challenges in BDA for large-scale wireless networks according to each stage in the life cycle of BDA. Moreover, we discuss the open research issues and outline the future directions in this promising area.

result.paraphrase: The rapid spread of diverse wireless communication systems and devices has ushered in the big data era for large-scale wireless networks. Such network data are characterized by great variety, massive volume, real-time velocity, and substantial value, creating research challenges that differ from those of existing computing systems. In this article, we survey the current state of the art in big data analytics (BDA) for large-scale wireless networks. Specifically, we divide the BDA lifecycle into four sequential stages: data acquisition, data preprocessing, data storage, and data analytics. We then provide a detailed review of technical solutions to BDA challenges in large-scale wireless networks at each stage of this lifecycle. Finally, we discuss open research issues and outline future directions in this promising field.
